basic_info.description: Welcome to 630 9th Avea beautifully renovated flat offering 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and modern living in the heart of San Francisco. Enjoy an open layout, sleek kitchen with high-end appliances, in-unit laundry, and shared outdoor space. Includes attached garage parking. Ideally located near Golden Gate Park, top-rated McCoppin Elementary, shops, dining, and public transit. Urban convenience meets contemporary comfort in this stunning home.
